purpose: Implement and prepare, without training, one immutable offline diagnostic that gives the nonlinear state-action interaction layer 32 updates after a one-step output-layer bootstrap. This plan does not authorize optimizer execution, games, runtime smoke, packaging, promotion, or submission.
selected_hypothesis: After one output-layer bootstrap step, freezing the output readout and training only residual_head.0 for 32 full-batch updates will let the nonlinear state-action interaction representation separate positive from negative advantage rows within each action family. Continuing to train residual_head.2 would instead keep amplifying action-family bias.
hypothesis_falsifier: The hypothesis is insufficient if residual_head.0 has verified finite nonzero gradients and completes 32 safe updates, but the same family-polarity signs and positive-END suppression persist or the terminal practical alignment gates fail.

source_implementation.snapshot_definition: Enumerate regular files recursively, excluding every path with a __pycache__ or test_outputs component and every .pyc suffix. Sort by the unsigned UTF-8 bytes of each relative POSIX path in ascending lexicographic order. Hash the concatenation, for each file, of relative_path UTF-8 bytes, NUL, decimal byte_size ASCII, NUL, uppercase_file_sha256 ASCII, and LF.

required_capabilities: prepare one canonical no-training receipt without constructing an optimizer, changing parameters, or writing a checkpoint
validate the plan, parent rejection, initial checkpoint, manifest, dataset, source implementation, runtime, rows, memberships, and exact execution spec before optimizer construction
perform one output-readout bootstrap update followed by exactly 32 interaction-layer updates
retain one Adam object without reset across both stages while changing the trainable parameter set
evaluate safety after every update and record full diagnostics at the fixed milestones
publish one final or safety-stop checkpoint and one canonical accepted or rejected receipt without overwriting any input

fixed_training_inputs.advantages: Recompute GAE and float32 population normalization from the immutable initial checkpoint exactly once, require equality with the bound hashes, and hold all 830 values fixed for every update.
fixed_training_inputs.behavior_logprobabilities: Use the same 830 stored behavior log-probabilities for every update.
fixed_training_inputs.value_targets: Hold the initial-checkpoint targets fixed for diagnostics only; value loss is exactly zero.
fixed_training_inputs.row_order_and_sampled_indices: Use the same manifest-order rows and sampled indices for every update.

after_every_stage_2_update_record: optimizer step ordinal and per-parameter optimizer step state
loss, policy loss, anchor KL loss, entropy diagnostic, total gradient norm, and per-parameter gradient norms
parameter hashes and maximum absolute changes from initial and stage start
global aligned, anti-aligned, neutral counts, alignment score, lower empirical median, mean and maximum anchor KL, maximum TV, unique argmax count, and nonfinite counts
full_row_fields: sampled probability delta and oriented delta from the immutable initial checkpoint
diagnostic_contract.lower_empirical_median: Sort ascending and select index (n - 1) // 2 without averaging.

safety_gates.failure_action: Stop immediately, retain exactly one checkpoint reflecting the completed safe or failing post-step state as specified by the exception contract, write only a canonical rejected receipt and REJECTED marker, and do not retry.

prepare_receipt_must_bind: input checkpoint, manifest, dataset, source implementation, runtime, and thread hashes
all 830 ordered row identities, initial probabilities, fixed advantages, behavior log-probabilities, sampled indices, semantic identities, and option types
the frozen 4, 20, 31, and 43 END-control memberships and seven action-family memberships
the exact four-parameter optimizer universe, stage trainability, 1 plus 32 update schedule, diagnostic milestones, safety gates, terminal gates, and stop rules
proof that no optimizer was constructed, no parameter changed, and no checkpoint was written
implementation_tests: prepare constructs no optimizer, changes no parameter, and writes no checkpoint
wrong plan, parent, rejected-checkpoint use, input, dataset, row, family, fixed-input, source, runtime, or execution-spec binding fails before optimizer construction
Stage 1 changes exactly residual_head.2 weight and bias and creates state only for those tensors
Stage 2 freezes residual_head.2 bytes and Adam moments while changing exactly residual_head.0 weight and bias for 32 steps
both encoders and the value head remain byte-exact with no optimizer state and all value outputs remain exactly equal to initial
the same Adam object persists across all 33 updates and terminal optimizer step counters are exact
full diagnostics occur exactly at Stage 1 and Stage 2 updates 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32, while compact safety summaries cover all 32 Stage 2 updates
safety boundaries, lower-median boundaries, formerly failing group improvements, global practical thresholds, and inherited END gates are tested at and beyond each boundary
directional failure before update 32 does not cause an early stop, while any safety failure does
one terminal checkpoint and exactly one accepted or rejected receipt-marker pair are published without overwriting inputs or existing outputs
forbidden_changes: loading or continuing from the rejected iteration-005 or iteration-006 checkpoint
teacher-action imitation, behavior cloning, Gold-action labels, or replay-derived opponent-policy labels
END-specific loss, reward, duplication, reweighting, mask, or hand-coded protection
action-family-specific loss weights or training objectives

changes to reward, dataset, row order, sampled actions, fixed advantages, behavior log-probabilities, model architecture, features, teacher, deck, opponent population, behavior formula, PPO clip, or anchor formula
training either encoder or any value-head parameter
constructing a second optimizer, resetting Adam, changing the learning rate, or adapting the anchor coefficient
stopping early because a family, END, or practical-alignment gate has not yet passed
same-iteration retry, games, runtime smoke, packaging, promotion, Kaggle submission, or any strength claim
post_rejection_action_if_falsified: Do not add optimizer steps. Perform a read-only identifiability audit of duplicate and near-identical public-state, legal-action-set, and semantic-action rows with opposing advantages, including trajectory and GAE decomposition. This would test the current representation and targets, not reject RL generally.
execution_stop_rule: Implementation and a no-training prepare receipt must pass independent code and numerical-provenance audits before the root authors a separately hashed execution spec. This implementation plan itself runs no optimizer step and no game.
